title: Volume and Projection Inequalities I: Zonoids and Courtade's Conjecture
summary: We study volume and projection inequalities for zonoids through the multiaffine determinant polynomials that encode their volumes. We show that a log-submodularity conjecture for the volume of zonoids is equivalent to the Rayleigh property of zonotope volume polynomials, which we prove for the case when the degree or codegree is at most 3. This result is sharp in that when the degree and codegree are at least 4, we construct counterexamples using the existence of non-Rayleigh matroids in ranks at least four.
